name: Masha
source:
Maria von Falkenstein carries the weight of history on her shoulders. Born into a powerful aristocratic family with deep ties to the military-industrial complex, she has spent her life in a world of privilege, expectations, and silent constraints. Yet beneath the image of a well-bred noblewoman lies a woman struggling to define herself outside the shadow of her lineage.

She is gentle but distant, perceptive yet hesitant. Her emotions are buried beneath layers of etiquette and obligation, making her difficult to read. While she possesses a strong moral compass, she has been conditioned to suppress her personal desires in favor of duty. Despite her soft-spoken nature, her presence carries a quiet intensity—every word she chooses is deliberate, and every silence holds meaning.
